name: lookout
description: See every AI coding agent session at a glance: what is working, what needs you, and where. Works with Claude Code.

commands.title: Jump to Next Session That Needs You

lookout.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the session counts in the status bar.

lookout.statusBar.showUsage.description: Show the 5-hour and weekly usage in the status bar item.

lookout.statusBar.usageReset.markdownDescription: Show how long until the 5-hour window resets after the usage bar, for example `32% · 1h12m`. Needs `#lookout.statusBar.showUsage#`.

enumDescriptions: Fetch fresh usage numbers only when you run Lookout: Refresh Usage or click the usage item.
Fetch when the numbers are older than 10 minutes or a window has reset; at most every 3 minutes on the machine, less often while fetches fail.
Never run the Claude Code binary; show only what Claude Code cached.
lookout.usage.refresh.markdownDescription: How Lookout keeps the usage numbers fresh. A refresh starts the Claude Code binary from the Claude Code extension and asks it for the account's usage; it fetches with its own credentials and calls no model. Lookout never reads your credentials. Never more than once every 3 minutes on the machine, across VS Code windows; after a fetch that brings no new numbers the wait doubles each time, up to 30 minutes (`Lookout: Refresh Usage` waits only for the 3 minutes). While `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` is set for Claude Code, Lookout does not refresh and shows only what Claude Code cached.

lookout.usage.alerts.description: Say when the 5-hour window reaches 70% and 90%, and the weekly limit 90%: once per window, in the VS Code window in front (any window when none is) and, while VS Code is not in front, on the desktop.

lookout.notifications.waiting.description: Notify when a session of this window starts to wait for you and you are not looking at it.

lookout.notifications.done.description: Notify when a session of this window finishes a turn and you are not looking at it.

lookout.notifications.os.markdownDescription: While VS Code is not the window in front, also show a notification on the desktop for what `#lookout.notifications.waiting#` and `#lookout.notifications.done#` announce. Uses the desktop's own tools (notify-send, osascript, Windows PowerShell, also from WSL); on SSH and container remotes there is no desktop to reach, and only the notification in the window shows.

lookout.notifications.sound.description: Play a short system sound with each desktop notification.

lookout.notifications.cooldownSeconds.description: Desktop notifications for the same session and the same event come at most this often. While three or more sessions need you, one notification sums them up instead.

lookout.state.typedQuestions.markdownDescription: Count an idle session as needing you when its last message asks you something: it ends with a question mark, or asks for a choice or a yes/no. Lookout reads this from the reply rather than from the agent, so the card marks it as less certain; dismiss it with the card's ✓.

lookout.claudeConfigDir.markdownDescription: Claude Code config directory to read sessions from. Empty uses `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` from the Claude Code extension's settings or the environment, then `~/.claude`.
